rubrics.criterion: Expense list shows recurring expenses with monthly equivalents, tag color, recurrence badge Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Yearly, and a total monthly net that reflects negative income.
Adding an expense with name, price, currency from 170+, recurrence, first payment date, and tag immediately appears in list with correctly calculated monthly cost and updated total.

Tapping an expense opens detail/edit with name, description, price, currency, recurrence, first date, tag with extended palette/custom picker, save validation, and delete with confirmation that leaves data unchanged on cancel.
Upcoming payments tab shows chronological timeline of due dates in next 30 days derived from first payment date plus recurrence, with empty and populated states.
Tags system with color palette/custom picker and filter chips that filter expense list, plus searchable multi-currency picker 170+ that converts to default currency and persists.
